text.en:
The Sitio of Landoc in Barangay Inerangan, Municipality of Alaminos, Province of Pangasinan,
is hereby separated from Barangay Inerangan and constituted into a new barangay in said municipality to be
known as Barangay Landoc.

Barangay Landoc shall be bounded and described as follows:
"A proposed Barangay Landoc, being a portion of Barangay Inerangan, Municipality of Alaminos, Province
of Pangasinan, Island of Luzon. Bounded on the N.E., along line 3-4 by proposed Barangay San Antonio; on
the S.E., along line 4-1 by Barangay Pugo (now), Barangay San Roque (before); at point 1, by Barangay
Amambangan; and on the S.W., along line 1-2 by Barangay Tawin-Tawin; on the N.W., along line 2-3 by
Barangay Inerangan. Beginning at a point marked "1" on the proposed plan of Barangay Landoc, being N.
66°, 58?W., 3,559.77 m. from BLLM No. 1, CAD-325-D Alaminos Cadastre; thence N. 55°, 29?W., 154.43
m. to point 2; thence N. 50°, 00?E., 940.00 m. to point 3; thence S. 23°, 33?E., 1,434.05 m. to point 4; thence
S. 07 deg. 31?W., 164.40 m. to point of beginning, containing an area of seventy-six point zero one hundred
thirty four hectares (76.0134). All points referred to are indicated on the prepared plan and marked on the
ground as follows: points 2, 3 & 4 are P.S. cyl. Conc. Mons. (15 x 60 cm.); point 1 by B.B.M. No. 29.
Bearings true, date prepared Feb. 18, 1982."
